name: raygister
description: Read your construction projects and DPGF lines, and manage your Raygister library.

interface.longDescription:
Raygister is where architects and project managers describe a construction project in lots and specifications, the lines of its DPGF (bill of quantities).

With Raygister in ChatGPT, you can read your projects: their lots, their lines with quantities, units and unit prices, their rooms and zones, and their totals excluding and including VAT, per lot and per VAT rate. You can also manage your organization's library, the content reused from one project to the next: trades, library groups, work items with their reference prices, and the supplies they prescribe. Load a supplier's price list, reprice work items, link supplies to work items, archive what is no longer used and restore it later.

Projects are read-only: the app does not create projects, edit DPGF lines, launch consultations or contact companies. Library writes are limited to your organization and your role. Requires a Raygister account.
capabilities: Read projects, lots and DPGF lines
Manage library trades, groups, work items and supplies
defaultPrompt: What are the totals excluding and including VAT of my latest project, per lot?
List the unpriced lines of the electricity lot of my renovation project.
Add these 20 supplies from my supplier's price list to my Raygister library.

positive.description: Read a project's totals per lot
positive.prompt: What is the total of the Haussmann apartment project, excluding and including VAT, per lot?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Haussmann apartment project and answers its amounts per lot, the VAT per rate, the fees apart, and the number of lines without a price.

positive.description: Find the unpriced lines of a lot
positive.prompt: In the Haussmann apartment project, list the lines of the electricity lot without a unit price.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the lines of the electricity lot whose unit price is empty, with their reference, quantity and unit.

positive.prompt: Add these three supplies to my library: Prise 2P+T Céliane, Legrand, reference 067111, 8.90 EUR; Interrupteur Céliane, Legrand, reference 067001, 7.40 EUR; Disjoncteur 16A, Schneider, reference A9F74216, 12.50 EUR.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the three supplies in the organization's library and confirms their names.

positive.description: Create a work item and link a supply
positive.prompt: Create a work item 'Pose de prise 16A' at 45 EUR per unit in the electricity group of my library and link the supply 'Prise 2P+T Mosaic' to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the work item in the electricity group at 45 EUR per unit and links the Legrand socket supply to it.

positive.description: Archive a supply, then restore it
positive.prompt: Archive the supply 'Peinture test' in my library, then restore it.
positive.expected_behavior: Archives the supply, then restores it with a second call; the supply ends up active and nothing is deleted.

negative.description: Projects are read-only: no tool deletes a project, so the app says it cannot and changes nothing.
Project lines are read-only: no tool edits a DPGF line, so the app says it cannot and changes nothing.
negative.prompt: Change the unit price of line ELEC-004 to 60 EUR.

negative.description: No tool contacts companies or launches a consultation, so the app says it cannot and sends nothing.
negative.prompt: Send the DPGF to three electricians.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: 30 tools, projects read-only, library read and write, OAuth sign-in.

fr-FR.subtitle: DPGF et bibliothèque chantier
fr-FR.description:
Raygister est l'outil où les architectes et les maîtres d'œuvre décrivent un projet de construction en lots et en spécifications, les lignes de sa DPGF.

Avec Raygister dans ChatGPT, vous lisez vos projets : leurs lots, leurs lignes avec quantités, unités et prix unitaires, leurs localisations et leurs totaux HT et TTC, par lot et par taux de TVA. Vous gérez aussi la bibliothèque de votre organisation, ce que vous réutilisez d'un projet à l'autre : corps d'état, groupes, ouvrages avec leurs prix de référence et fournitures prescrites. Chargez le tarif d'un fournisseur, mettez à jour les prix de vos ouvrages, liez des fournitures aux ouvrages, archivez ce qui ne sert plus et restaurez-le plus tard.

Les projets sont en lecture seule : l'application ne crée pas de projet, ne modifie pas les lignes de la DPGF, ne lance pas de consultation et ne contacte aucune entreprise. Les écritures dans la bibliothèque sont limitées à votre organisation et à votre rôle. Un compte Raygister est nécessaire.
